tools.name: termii_get_balance
tools.description: Return the Termii wallet balance, its currency and the account name. Good first call: it also confirms the API key works. Termii API: GET /api/get-balance.

tools.name: termii_get_message_history
tools.description: List messages sent from this account across sms, voice, email and whatsapp, with status, recipient and cost. Pass message_id (from a send response) to get one message. Termii API: GET /api/sms/inbox.

tools.name: termii_check_dnd_status
tools.description: Check whether a phone number is on the Do-Not-Disturb list, and its mobile network. Use it before a promotional (generic) send: DND numbers block generic messages. Termii API: GET /api/check/dnd.

tools.name: termii_list_sender_ids
tools.description: List the Sender IDs on this account with their status (active, pending or blocked). A message can only use an active Sender ID. Termii API: GET /api/sender-id.

tools.name: termii_send_message
tools.description: Send an SMS to one number or up to 100 numbers. This sends a real message and uses wallet credit. Use channel dnd for OTP and transactional messages (also reaches DND numbers). Use channel generic only for promotional messages. SMS only: WhatsApp and voice channels are not exposed. Termii API: POST

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: termii_get_message_history, termii_check_dnd_status, termii_list_sender_ids · Private data: termii_get_balance, termii_send_message · Public sink: termii_get_message_history, termii_check_dnd_status, termii_send_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: termii_get_message_history, termii_check_dnd_status, termii_list_sender_ids · Private data: termii_get_balance, termii_send_message · Public sink: termii_get_message_history, termii_check_dnd_status, termii_send_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
